facts.value: The Faculty of Arts, Humanities and Social Sciences (AHSS) is a dynamic community where ideas are explored, challenged, and brought to life. It offers high-quality teaching and a rich research environment that spans traditional disciplines and innovative interdisciplinary work.

metadata.chunk_title: Arts, Humanities and Social Sciences + Education and Health Sciences + The Kemmy Business School + Faculty of Science and Engineering + The Irish World Academy of Music and Dance

facts.value: The Education and Health Sciences (EHS) Faculty includes the Schools of Medicine, Allied Health, Education, and Nursing and Midwifery as well as the Departments of Psychology, Physical Education and Sport Sciences. The faculty has built a reputation for high-quality teaching and innovative academic programmes.

metadata.chunk_title: Arts, Humanities and Social Sciences + Education and Health Sciences + The Kemmy Business School + Faculty of Science and Engineering + The Irish World Academy of Music and Dance

facts.value: The Kemmy Business School (KBS) is a dynamic, innovative business school with a reputation, established over 30 years, for delivering a first-class business education that prepares graduates for successful, rewarding careers across a wide range of business disciplines and professions.

metadata.chunk_title: Arts, Humanities and Social Sciences + Education and Health Sciences + The Kemmy Business School + Faculty of Science and Engineering + The Irish World Academy of Music and Dance

facts.value: The Faculty of Science and Engineering is well recognised for the quality of its teaching and learning, academic programmes and research expertise. It has three world-class research institutes in Materials and Surface Sciences, Software Engineering and Mathematics, all underpinned by well-established industry links.

metadata.chunk_title: Arts, Humanities and Social Sciences + Education and Health Sciences + The Kemmy Business School + Faculty of Science and Engineering + The Irish World Academy of Music and Dance

facts.value: The Irish World Academy of Music and Dance is the centre of academic and performance excellence at University of Limerick, Ireland. It honours the energies of performance and academic reflection across a wide range of genres and disciplines.
